sentences.zh: 天福六年秋七月己未朔，帝御崇元殿視朝。

translations.literal: On the jiuwei new moon in autumn, seventh month of Tianfu 6, the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Chongyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiuwei new moon of the seventh month of Tianfu 6, the Emperor held court in Chongyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，升陳州為防禦使額。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chen Prefecture was elevated to the designation of defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Chen Prefecture was raised to defense-commissioner status.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前鄧州節度使焦方為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the former military governor of Deng Prefecture, Jiao Fang, was made military governor of Bei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Jiao Fang, former governor of Deng, was appointed governor of Bei.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，涇州奏，西涼府留後李文謙，今年二月四日閉宅門自焚，遣元入西涼府譯語官與來人賫三部族蕃書進之。

translations.literal: On renxu, Jing Prefecture reported that Li Wenqian, acting commissioner of Xiliang Prefecture, on the fourth day of the second month of this year closed his residence gate and burned himself; he sent a native of Xiliang, an interpreter official, together with the envoy to present tribal documents of three clans.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Jing reported that Li Wenqian, regent of Xiliang, had shut his gates and burned himself on the fourth of the second month; a Xiliang native interpreter came with the envoy bearing tribal documents from three clans.

sentences.zh: 以三司使劉審交為陳州防禦使。

translations.literal: Liu Shenjiao, commissioner of the Three Departments, was made defense commissioner of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shenjiao, Three Departments commissioner, was named defense commissioner of Chen.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以前鄆州節度使趙在禮為許州節度使，以前鄴都留守、廣晉尹高行周為河南尹、西都留守。

translations.literal: On guihai, the former military governor of Yan Prefecture, Zhao Zaili, was made military governor of Xu Prefecture; the former regent of Yedu and Guangjin prefect, Gao Xingzhou, was made prefect of Henan and regent of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhao Zaili, former Yan governor, took Xu; Gao Xingzhou, former Yedu regent and Guangjin prefect, became Henan prefect and Western Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 詔改拱辰、威和、內直等軍並為興順。

translations.literal: An edict changed the armies Gongchen, Weihe, Neizhi, and others all to Xingshun.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed the Gongchen, Weihe, Neizhi, and related armies Xingshun.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以宣徽使、權西京留守張從恩判三司。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Zhang Cong'en, palace commissioner and acting regent of the Western Capital, was assigned to oversee the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Cong'en, palace commissioner and acting Western Capital regent, was put in charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以鄴都留守兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、廣晉尹劉知遠為太原尹，充北京留守、河東節度使，仍割遼、沁二州卻隸河東。

translations.literal: On jisi, Liu Zhiyuan, regent of Yedu and concurrently commander of the palace horse-and-foot armies and Guangjin prefect, was made Taiyuan prefect, charged as regent of the Northern Capital and military governor of Hedong; the two prefectures Liao and Qin were cut away and returned to Hedong jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Liu Zhiyuan, Yedu regent, palace army commander, and Guangjin prefect, became Taiyuan prefect, Northern Capital regent, and Hedong governor; Liao and Qin were restored to Hedong.

sentences.zh: 以北京留守李德充為廣晉尹，充鄴都留守；

translations.literal: Li Dechong, regent of the Northern Capital, was made Guangjin prefect and charged as regent of Yedu;
translations.idiomatic: Li Dechong, Northern Capital regent, became Guangjin prefect and Yedu regent;

sentences.zh: 以昭義節度使馬全節為邢州節度使，加同平章事。

translations.literal: Ma Quanjie, military governor of Zhaoyi, was made military governor of Xing Prefecture and given the additional title of co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Quanjie, Zhaoyi governor, was transferred to Xing and made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「今後諸道行軍副使，不得奏薦骨肉為殿直供奉官。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict stated: "Henceforth campaign deputy commanders of all circuits may not memorialize recommending kin as palace attendants or tribute commissioners."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict declared: "Campaign deputies on all circuits may no longer recommend relatives for palace attendant or tribute posts."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，以前陜州節度使李從敏為昭義軍節度使，以陜州節度使景延廣為河陽三城節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍都虞候，以河陽節度使石赟為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: " On jimao, the former military governor of Shan Prefecture, Li Congmin, was made military governor of the Zhaoyi army; Jing Yanguang, military governor of Shan, was made military governor of the Three Cities of Heyang and concurrently chief adjutant of the palace horse-and-foot armies; Shi Yun, military governor of Heyang, was made military governor of Shan.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao Li Congmin, former Shan governor, took Zhaoyi; Jing Yanguang left Shan for the Three Cities of Heyang and became palace army chief adjutant; Shi Yun moved from Heyang to Shan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，突厥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Turk envoys arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 以遙領壽州忠正軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李懷忠為同州節度使，以宣徽北院使李守貞遙領忠正軍節度使、侍衛馬軍指揮使。

translations.literal: Li Huaizhong, titular military governor of the Zhongzheng army at Shou Prefecture and concurrently commander of the palace horse army, was made military governor of Tong Prefecture; Li Shouzhen, commissioner of the Northern Palace Bureau, was given titular command of the Zhongzheng army and the palace horse army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaizhong, titular Zhongzheng governor at Shou and palace horse commander, became Tong governor; Li Shouzhen of the Northern Palace Bureau was named titular Zhongzheng governor and horse army commander.

sentences.zh: 甲申，降御劄，取八月五日暫幸鄴都，沿路供頓，並委所司以官物排比，州縣不得科率人戶。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an imperial rescript was issued: on the fifth day of the eighth month the court would temporarily visit Yedu; supplies along the route were all entrusted to the relevant offices to arrange from government stores—prefectures and counties might not levy the populace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen a rescript set the fifth of the eighth month for a temporary visit to Yedu; route supplies were to come from official stores only—no levies on households.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以右諫議大夫趙遠為中書舍人，吏部郎中鄭受益為右諫議大夫，刑部郎中殷鵬為水部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Zhao Yuan, right remonstrance grandee, was made Secretariat drafter; Zheng Shouyi, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made right remonstrance grandee; Yin Peng, bureau director in the Ministry of Justice, was made bureau director in the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhao Yuan became Secretariat drafter; Zheng Shouyi moved from Personnel to right remonstrator; Yin Peng became Works director and edict drafter.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子朔，以皇子開封尹、鄭王重貴為東京留守，以天平軍節度使兼侍衛親軍馬步軍副都指揮使杜重威為侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使，以宣徽南院使張從恩為東京內外兵馬都監。

translations.literal: On the wuzi new moon of the eighth month, the imperial prince, Kaifeng prefect, and Prince of Zheng, Chonggui, was made regent of the Eastern Capital; Du Chongwei, military governor of the Tianping army and deputy commander of the palace horse-and-foot armies, was made commander of the palace armies; Zhang Cong'en, commissioner of the Southern Palace Bureau, was made overall supervisor of Eastern Capital forces within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the eighth month Prince Chonggui of Zheng, Kaifeng prefect, became Eastern Capital regent; Du Chongwei, Tianping governor and palace army deputy, took full command; Zhang Cong'en supervised all Eastern Capital troops.

sentences.zh: 改奉德馬軍為護聖。

translations.literal: The Fengde horse army was renamed Husheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Fengde horse army was renamed Husheng.

sentences.zh: 放文武百官朝參，取便先赴鄴都。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were released from court attendance and might proceed to Yedu at their convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were excused from court and could go on to Yedu when convenient.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，車駕發東京。

translations.literal: On renchen, the imperial carriage departed the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Emperor left the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己亥，至鄴，左右金吾六軍儀仗排列如儀，迎引入內。

translations.literal: On jihai, the court arrived at Ye; the Left and Right Golden Crow guards and the six armies formed escort according to ritual and welcomed the Emperor within.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the court reached Ye; Golden Crow guards and the six armies formed the prescribed escort and led the Emperor in.

sentences.zh: 改舊澶州為德清軍。

translations.literal: The former Chanzou was made the Deqing army.
translations.idiomatic: Former Chanzou was redesignated the Deqing army.

sentences.zh: 以內客省使劉遂清為宣徽北院使，判三司。

translations.literal: Liu Suqing, commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau, was made commissioner of the Northern Palace Bureau and assigned to oversee the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Suqing, Inner Guests commissioner, became Northern Palace commissioner and took charge of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，制：「應天福六年八月十五日昧爽已前，諸色罪犯，常赦所不原者，咸赦除之；

translations.literal: On renyin, a statute stated: "For all offenses before dawn on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of Tianfu 6, even those not normally pardoned in regular amnesties, pardon and remission are granted in full;"
translations.idiomatic: On renyin a statute declared: "All crimes before dawn on the fifteenth of the eighth month of Tianfu 6—even those outside ordinary amnesties—are fully pardoned;"

sentences.zh: 其持仗行劫及殺人賊，並免罪移鄉，配逐處軍都收管；

translations.literal: armed robbers and murderers are all spared punishment but relocated, assigned to the local army command for custody;
translations.idiomatic: armed robbers and murderers are spared but banished to local army custody;

sentences.zh: 犯枉法贓者，雖免罪不得再任用；

translations.literal: those guilty of unlawful bribes, though spared punishment, may not be employed again;
translations.idiomatic: bribe-takers are pardoned but barred from office forever;

sentences.zh: 諸徒流人並放還；

translations.literal: all penal exiles and convicts are released and sent home;
translations.idiomatic: all exiles and convicts are sent home;

sentences.zh: 貶降官未量移與量移者，約資敘用。

translations.literal: demoted officials, whether or not yet reassigned, are to be considered for reinstatement according to qualification.
translations.idiomatic: demoted officials, reassigned or not, may be considered for reinstatement by qualification.

sentences.zh: 天福五年終已前殘稅並放。

translations.literal: All outstanding taxes before the end of Tianfu 5 are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All tax arrears through the end of Tianfu 5 are forgiven.

sentences.zh: 應河東起義之初及收復鄴都、汜水立功將校，並與加恩；

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers who won merit at the beginning of the Hedong uprising and in recovering Yedu and Sishui are all to receive added favor;
translations.idiomatic: Officers who distinguished themselves in the Hedong uprising and the recoveries of Yedu and Sishui are to be rewarded;

sentences.zh: 亡歿者與追贈。

translations.literal: the deceased are to receive posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: the dead are to receive posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 自東京至鄴都緣路，昨因行幸，有損踐田苗處，據頃畝與放今年租稅。

translations.literal: Along the route from the Eastern Capital to Yedu, wherever crops were trampled during the recent progress, this year's rent and tax are remitted by measured acreage.
translations.idiomatic: Crops damaged along the Eastern Capital–Yedu route during the imperial tour are exempt from this year's rent and tax by acreage.

sentences.zh: 鄴都管內，有潛龍時在職者，並與加恩。

translations.literal: Within the Yedu circuit, all who held office during the "hidden dragon" period receive added favor.
translations.idiomatic: All who served in Yedu during Gaozu's rise there are to be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 耆年八十已上者，版授上佐官。

translations.literal: The elderly eighty years and above are granted nominal upper-assistant posts by patent.
translations.idiomatic: Those eighty and older receive honorary upper-assistant titles.

sentences.zh: 天下農器，並許百姓自鑄造。

translations.literal: Throughout the realm, farming implements may all be cast by commoners themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners may cast their own farm tools throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 亡命山澤者，招喚歸業；

translations.literal: Fugitives in mountains and marshes are summoned to return to their livelihoods;
translations.idiomatic: Fugitives in the wilds are called home to their trades;

sentences.zh: 百日不出者，復罪如初。

translations.literal: those who do not emerge within a hundred days are punished as before.
translations.idiomatic: those who fail to appear within a hundred days face their original penalties.

sentences.zh: 唐梁國公狄仁傑宜追贈官秩。

translations.literal: Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, should receive posthumous rank.
translations.idiomatic: Di Renjie, Tang's Duke of Liang, is to receive posthumous rank.

sentences.zh: 應天福三年已前，敗闕場院官無家業者，並與除放，其人免罪，永不任使。

translations.literal: Before Tianfu 3, market-yard officials who failed in duty and had no family estate are all dismissed and released; the persons are spared punishment but never employed again.
translations.idiomatic: Market-yard officials who failed before Tianfu 3 and lacked estates are dismissed, pardoned, and barred from office forever.

sentences.zh: 私下債負征利及一倍者並放，主持者不在此限。

translations.literal: Private debts with interest charged up to double the principal are all remitted; brokers are not under this limit.
translations.idiomatic: Private debts with interest up to double principal are forgiven—except for brokers.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，以客省使、將作監丁知浚為內客省使，引進使、鴻臚卿王景崇為客省使，殿中監、判四方館事劉政恩為引進使。

translations.literal: " On dingwei, Ding Zhijun, commissioner of the Guests Bureau and director of imperial construction, was made commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau; Wang Jingchong, introduction commissioner and director of the Court of State Ceremonial, was made commissioner of the Guests Bureau; Liu Zheng'en, director of the Palace Directorate and overseer of the Four Directions Office, was made introduction commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingwei Ding Zhijun became Inner Guests commissioner; Wang Jingchong took the Guests Bureau; Liu Zheng'en became introduction commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，改鄴都皇城南門應天門為乾明門，大明館為都亭驛。

translations.literal: On renzi, the Yedu imperial-city south gate Yingtian Gate was renamed Qianming Gate, and the Daming Hostel was renamed the Capital Pavilion relay.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Yedu's south gate Yingtian became Qianming, and the Daming Hostel became the capital relay station.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣光祿卿張澄、國子博士謝攀使高麗行冊禮。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Director of Banquets Zhang Cheng and Erudite of the National University Xie Pan were sent as envoys to Goryeo to perform investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhang Cheng and Xie Pan were dispatched to Goryeo for investiture ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以兵部侍郎閻至為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiwei, Yan Zhi, vice minister of War, was made vice minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the ninth month Yan Zhi moved from War to Personnel vice minister.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，滑州河決，一溉東流，鄉村戶民攜老幼登丘冢，為水所隔，餓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Yellow River burst its banks at Hua Prefecture; a single flood flowed east. Rural households carried the old and young onto mounds and tombs, cut off by the water; those who starved to death were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the river broke at Hua and poured east; villagers fled with families to high ground, trapped by floodwaters, and starvation was widespread.

sentences.zh: 壬申，忠武建武等軍節度使、守太傅、兼中書令、行蘇州睦州刺史錢元尞進封彭城郡王，遙領廣州清海軍節度使、判婺州軍州事錢元懿為檢校太師。

translations.literal: On renshen, Qian Yuanliao, military governor of the Zhongwu and Jianwu armies, holder of Grand Mentor, concurrently Secretariat director, and acting prefect of Suzhou and Muzhou, was advanced to Prince of Pengcheng commandery; Qian Yuanyi, titular military governor of the Qinghai army at Guangzhou and administrator of Wuzhou, was made honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Qian Yuanliao, Zhongwu-Jianwu governor and acting Suzhou-Muzhou prefect, was made Prince of Pengcheng; Qian Yuanyi, titular Qinghai governor at Guangzhou and Wuzhou administrator, was named honorary Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣前邢州節度使楊彥詢使於契丹，錫賫甚厚。

translations.literal: On yihai, the former military governor of Xing Prefecture, Yang Yanxun, was sent as envoy to the Khitan; gifts and rewards were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai former Xing governor Yang Yanxun was sent to the Khitan with lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，吐渾遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Tuyuhun envoys arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午夜，有彗星出於西方，長二丈餘，在房一度，尾跡穿天市垣東行，逾月而滅。

translations.literal: At midnight on renwu, a comet appeared in the west, more than two zhang in length, in the first degree of Fang; its tail crossed the eastern Celestial Market Enclosure and moved east, vanishing after more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight on renwu a comet appeared in the west, over two zhang long in Fang's first degree; its tail crossed the eastern Market Enclosure eastward and faded after a month.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，兗州上言，水自西來，漂沒秋稼。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Yan Prefecture reported that water came from the west and washed away the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Yan reported western floodwaters had destroyed the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥朔，遣鴻臚少卿魏比等四人，分往滑、濮、鄆、澶視水害苗稼。

translations.literal: On the dinghai new moon in winter, tenth month, Vice Director of State Ceremonial Wei Bi and three others were sent separately to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Chan to inspect flood damage to crops.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the tenth month Wei Bi and three others were dispatched to Hua, Pu, Yan, and Chan to survey flood damage.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔以胡梁度月城為大通軍，浮橋為大通橋。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict named the Huliang ferry moon-city the Datong army and the pontoon bridge the Datong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict renamed the Huliang ferry settlement Datong army and its pontoon Datong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔唐梁國公狄仁傑可贈太師。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict stated that Di Renjie, Duke of Liang of Tang, may be posthumously given Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict granted Di Renjie, Tang's Duke of Liang, posthumous Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌朔，以東京留守、開封尹、鄭王重貴為廣晉尹，進封齊王；

translations.literal: On the bingxu new moon of the twelfth month, Chonggui, regent of the Eastern Capital, Kaifeng prefect, and Prince of Zheng, was made Guangjin prefect and advanced to Prince of Qi;
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the twelfth month Chonggui of Zheng, Eastern Capital regent and Kaifeng prefect, became Guangjin prefect and was advanced to Prince of Qi;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都留守、廣晉尹李德充為開封尹，充東京留守。

translations.literal: Li Dechong, regent of Yedu and Guangjin prefect, was made Kaifeng prefect and charged as regent of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dechong, Yedu regent and Guangjin prefect, became Kaifeng prefect and Eastern Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 南面軍前奏，十一月二十七日，武德使焦繼勛、先鋒都指揮使郭金海等於唐州南遇安從進賊軍一萬餘人，大破之，

translations.literal: The southern army front reported that on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month, Wude commissioner Jiao Jixun, vanguard commander Guo Jinhai, and others south of Tang Prefecture encountered more than ten thousand troops of the rebel An Congjin and routed them greatly,
translations.idiomatic: The southern front reported that on the twenty-seventh of the eleventh month Jiao Jixun, Guo Jinhai, and others met over ten thousand of An Congjin's rebels south of Tang and crushed them,

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《宋史·陳思讓傳》：思讓為先鋒右廂都監，從武德焦繼勛領兵進討，遇從進之師於唐州花山下，急擊，大破之。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Song History · Biography of Chen Sirang》 states: Sirang was vanguard right-wing supervisor; following Wude commissioner Jiao Jixun he led troops in pursuit, met Congjin's army below Flower Mountain in Tang Prefecture, attacked urgently, and routed them greatly.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Song History · Chen Sirang》 says Sirang commanded the vanguard right wing under Jiao Jixun, met Congjin below Flower Mountain in Tang, attacked at once, and routed him.)〉

sentences.zh: 生擒衙內都指揮使安宏義，獲山南東道之印，其安從進單騎奔逸。

translations.literal: capturing alive the yamen commander An Hongyi, seizing the seal of the Shannan East circuit; An Congjin himself fled on a single horse.
translations.idiomatic: taking An Hongyi, yamen commander, alive and capturing the Shannan East seal; Congjin himself fled alone.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔襄州行營都部署高行周權知襄州軍州事。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict made Gao Xingzhou, overall deployer of the Xiangzhou field camp, acting administrator of Xiangzhou military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Gao Xingzhou, Xiangzhou field commander, was named acting Xiangzhou administrator.

sentences.zh: 是日，鎮州節度使安重榮稱兵向闕，以侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使杜重威為北面行營招討使，率兵擊之，以邢州節度使馬全節為副，以前貝州節度使王周為馬步軍都虞候。

translations.literal: That day, An Chongrong, military governor of Zhen Prefecture, raised troops toward the capital; Du Chongwei, commander of the palace horse-and-foot armies, was made northern campaign commissioner to lead troops against him; Ma Quanjie, military governor of Xing, was deputy; Wang Zhou, former military governor of Bei, was chief adjutant of horse and foot.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Zhen governor An Chongrong marched on the capital; palace army commander Du Chongwei was named northern campaign commissioner, with Xing governor Ma Quanjie as deputy and former Bei governor Wang Zhou as chief adjutant.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，武德使焦繼勛奏，安從進遣弟從貴領兵千人，取接均州刺史蔡行遇，尋領所部兵掩殺賊軍七百餘人，生擒安從貴，截其雙腕，卻放入城。

translations.literal: On guisi, Wude commissioner Jiao Jixun reported that An Congjin sent his younger brother Conggui leading a thousand troops to link up with Jun Prefecture prefect Cai Xingyu; soon afterward he led his troops in a surprise attack killing more than seven hundred rebel troops, capturing Conggui alive, cutting off both his wrists, and then releasing him back into the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Jiao Jixun reported Congjin's brother Conggui led a thousand men to join Jun prefect Cai Xingyu, then ambushed and killed seven hundred rebels, captured Conggui, severed both wrists, and sent him back into the city.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以皇子重睿為銀青光祿大夫、檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the imperial prince Chongrui was made Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and honorary Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince Chongrui was made Silver-Gleam grand master and honorary Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己亥，北面軍前奏，十三日未時，於宗城縣西南大破鎮州賊軍，殺一萬五千人，餘黨走保宗城縣。

translations.literal: On jihai, the northern army front reported that on the thirteenth day at the wei hour they greatly routed the Zhen Prefecture rebel army southwest of Zongcheng County, killing fifteen thousand; the remainder fled to hold Zongcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the northern front reported that on the thirteenth at the wei hour they routed Zhen rebels southwest of Zongcheng, killing fifteen thousand; survivors fled into Zongcheng County.

sentences.zh: 是夜三更，破縣城，前深州刺史史虔武自縛歸降。

translations.literal: That night at the third watch they stormed the county seat; Shi Qianwu, former prefect of Shen, bound himself and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That night at the third watch they took the county seat; former Shen prefect Shi Qianwu bound himself and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 獲馬三千匹，絹三萬餘匹，餘物稱是。

translations.literal: They captured three thousand horses, more than thirty thousand bolts of silk, and other goods in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: They seized three thousand horses, over thirty thousand bolts of silk, and comparable other booty.

sentences.zh: 安重榮脫身遁走。

translations.literal: An Chongrong slipped away and fled.
translations.idiomatic: An Chongrong escaped.

sentences.zh: 是日，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: That day the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: That day the court offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，削奪安從進、安重榮在身官爵。

translations.literal: On guimao, An Congjin and An Chongrong were stripped of all active titles and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Congjin and Chongrong were stripped of all titles and ranks.

sentences.zh: 右金吾上將軍萇從簡卒，廢朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: Chang Congjian, general-in-chief of the Right Golden Crow, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously given Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Right Golden Crow general-in-chief Chang Congjian died; court was suspended and he was posthumously named Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，天下兵馬都元帥、守尚書令、吳越國王錢元瓘薨，廢朝三日，謚曰文穆。

translations.literal: On yisi, Qian Yuanguan, commander-in-chief of all armies and horses, holder of Secretariat director, and King of Wuyue, died; court was suspended three days; his posthumous title was Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wuyue king Qian Yuanguan, commander-in-chief and Secretariat director, died; court mourned three days and gave him the posthumous title Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝習射於後苑，諸軍都指揮使已上悉預焉，賜物有差。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor practiced archery in the rear garden; all army commanders and above attended; gifts were given in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor practiced archery in the rear garden; army commanders and above attended and received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，南面行營都部署高行周奏，今月十三日，部領大軍至襄州城下，相次降賊軍二千人。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Gao Xingzhou, overall deployer of the southern field camp, reported that on the thirteenth day of this month he led the great army to below Xiangzhou city; rebel troops surrendered in succession, two thousand in all.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Gao Xingzhou reported reaching Xiangzhou on the thirteenth with the main army; two thousand rebels surrendered in succession.

sentences.zh: 其降兵馬軍詔以「彰聖」為號，步軍以「歸順」為號。

translations.literal: The surrendered horse troops were by edict given the designation Zhangsheng; the foot troops the designation Guishun.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered horse troops were named Zhangsheng; foot troops, Guishun.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以權知吳越國事錢宏佐為起復鎮軍大將軍、檢校太師、兼中書令、杭州越州大都督、鎮海鎮東等軍節度使，封吳越國王。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Qian Hongzuo, acting administrator of Wuyue affairs, was recalled from mourning as General-in-Chief of the Suppressing Army, honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrently Secretariat director, Grand Protector of Hangzhou and Yuezhou, and military governor of the Zhenhai and Zhendong armies, and enfeoffed as King of Wuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Qian Hongzuo, acting Wuyue administrator, was recalled from mourning as army general-in-chief, honorary Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, Hangzhou-Yuezhou protector, Zhenhai-Zhendong governor, and King of Wuyue.

sentences.zh: 壬子，杜重威部領大軍至鎮州城下。

translations.literal: On renzi, Du Chongwei led the great army to below Zhen Prefecture city.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Du Chongwei brought the main army to Zhen.

sentences.zh: 天福七年春正月丙辰朔，不受朝賀，用兵故也。

translations.literal: On the bingchen new moon in spring, first month of Tianfu 7, congratulations were not received at court, because of active military operations.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the first month of Tianfu 7 the court skipped New Year congratulations because of the war.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前將作監李鍇為少府監。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the former director of imperial construction, Li Kai, was made director of the Palace Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu former construction director Li Kai became Palace Workshops director.

sentences.zh: 北面招討使杜重威奏，今月二日收復鎮州，斬安重榮，傳首闕下。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, northern campaign commissioner, reported that on the second day of this month Zhen Prefecture was recovered, An Chongrong was beheaded, and his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Northern campaign commissioner Du Chongwei reported recovering Zhen on the second of the month, beheading Chongrong, and sending his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝御乾明樓，宣露布訖，大理卿受馘，付市徇之，百官稱賀。

translations.literal: The Emperor held court at Qianming Tower; when the victory bulletin had been proclaimed, the Director of the Court of Judicial Review received the severed head and handed it to the market for public display; the hundred officials offered congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor appeared at Qianming Tower; after the victory bulletin the chief justice took the head for public display in the market, and the court congratulated him.

sentences.zh: 曲赦廣晉府禁囚。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the Guangjin prefecture jail.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty freed Guangjin jail prisoners.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《遼史》云：戊辰，晉函安重榮首來獻，上數欲親討重榮，至是乃止。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Liao History》 states: On wuchen, Jin sent a box with An Chongrong's head as tribute; the Emperor had several times wished to campaign against Chongrong in person, and only then stopped.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Liao History》 says on wuchen Jin presented Chongrong's head in a box; the Liao emperor, who had repeatedly planned to campaign against him in person, then desisted.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，追贈皇弟三人：故沂州馬步軍都指揮使、贈太傅德再贈太尉，追封福王；

translations.literal: On xinyou, three imperial younger brothers were posthumously honored: the late horse-and-foot commander of Yi Prefecture, De, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Marshal, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Fu;
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou three younger brothers were posthumously honored: De, former Yi army commander, was raised from Grand Mentor to Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Fu;

sentences.zh: 故檢校太子賓客、贈太傅殷再贈太尉，追封通王；

translations.literal: the late honorary heir-apparent guest, Yin, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Marshal, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tong;
translations.idiomatic: Yin, former honorary heir-apparent guest, was raised to Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Tong;

sentences.zh: 故彰聖右第三軍都指揮使長州刺史、贈大傅威再贈太尉，追封廣王。

translations.literal: the late commander of the Zhangsheng Right Third Army and prefect of Chang Prefecture, Wei, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Marshal, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, former Zhangsheng Right Third Army commander and Chang prefect, was raised to Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Guang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，追贈皇子五人：故右衛將軍、贈太保重英再贈太傅，追封虢王；

translations.literal: On renxu, five imperial sons were posthumously honored: the late Right Guard general, Chongying, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Preceptor, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Guo;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu five sons were posthumously honored: Chongying, former Right Guard general, was raised from Grand Mentor to Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Guo;

sentences.zh: 故權東京留守、河南尹、贈太傅重乂再贈太尉，追封壽王；

translations.literal: the late acting Eastern Capital regent and Henan prefect, Chongyi, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Marshal, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, former acting Eastern Capital regent and Henan prefect, was raised to Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Shou;

sentences.zh: 故皇城副使、贈太保重裔再贈太傅，追封郯王；

translations.literal: the late deputy commissioner of the Imperial City, Chongyi, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Preceptor, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Tan;
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, former Imperial City deputy, was raised to Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Tan;

sentences.zh: 故河陽節度使、贈太尉重信再贈太師，追封沂王；

translations.literal: the late military governor of Heyang, Chongxin, posthumously given Grand Marshal and then Grand Preceptor, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yi;
translations.idiomatic: Chongxin, former Heyang governor, was raised to Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Yi;

sentences.zh: 故左金吾衛將軍、贈太保重進再贈太傅，追封夔王。

translations.literal: the late Left Golden Crow Guard general, Chongjin, posthumously given Grand Mentor and then Grand Preceptor, posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Chongjin, former Left Golden Crow general, was raised to Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Kui.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，改鎮州為恒州，成德軍為順國軍。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhen Prefecture was renamed Heng Prefecture, and the Chengde army was renamed the Shunguo army.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zhen became Heng and the Chengde army became Shunguo.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以門下侍郎、平章事、監修國史趙瑩為侍中；

translations.literal: On bingyin, Zhao Ying, vice director of the Chancellery, director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and overseer of the national history, was made Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhao Ying, Chancellery vice director, chief minister, and history overseer, became Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使楊光遠加食邑，改賜功臣名號；

translations.literal: Yang Guangyuan, military governor of Qing Prefecture, was given added fief income and a new merit-title designation;
translations.idiomatic: Qing governor Yang Guangyuan received added fief income and a new merit title;

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使桑維翰加檢校太保；

translations.literal: Sang Weihan, military governor of Yan Prefecture, was given honorary Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Yan governor Sang Weihan was named honorary Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 河東節度使劉知遠加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of Hedong, was given the additional title of Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Hedong governor Liu Zhiyuan was also made Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 以鄆州節度使、北面行營招討使、侍衛親軍都指揮使杜重威為恒州順國軍節度使，加兼侍中；

translations.literal: Du Chongwei, military governor of Yan Prefecture, northern campaign commissioner, and commander of the palace armies, was made military governor of the Shunguo army at Heng Prefecture and given the additional title of Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Yan governor, northern campaign commissioner, and palace commander Du Chongwei became Shunguo governor at Heng and Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 皇子廣晉尹兼功德使、齊王重貴加兼侍中；

translations.literal: the imperial prince, Guangjin prefect and merit commissioner, Prince of Qi Chonggui, was given the additional title of Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Chonggui, Guangjin prefect and merit commissioner, was also made Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: 秦州節度使侯益加特進，增食邑。

translations.literal: Hou Yi, military governor of Qin Prefecture, was given special advancement and increased fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Qin governor Hou Yi received special advancement and added fief income.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以判四方館事孟承誨為太府卿充職。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Meng Chenghui, overseer of the Four Directions Office, was made Director of the Grand Storehouse and confirmed in office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Meng Chenghui, Four Directions Office overseer, became Grand Storehouse director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以滄州節度使安叔千為邢州節度使，以北面行營副招討使、邢州節度使馬全節為定州節度使，以定州節度使王庭胤為滄州節度使，以前邢州節度使楊彥詢為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, An Shuqian, military governor of Cang Prefecture, was made military governor of Xing Prefecture; Ma Quanjie, deputy campaign commissioner of the northern headquarters and military governor of Xing Prefecture, was made military governor of Ding Prefecture; Wang Tingyin, military governor of Ding Prefecture, was made military governor of Cang Prefecture; Yang Yanxun, former military governor of Xing Prefecture, was made military governor of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Cang governor An Shuqian took Xing; northern deputy campaign commissioner and Xing governor Ma Quanjie took Ding; Ding governor Wang Tingyin took Cang; former Xing governor Yang Yanxun became Hua governor.

sentences.zh: 恒州立功將校王溫以降等第除郡。

translations.literal: Wang Wen, an officer who had earned merit at Heng Prefecture, was appointed to a prefecture according to a reduced rank grade.
translations.idiomatic: Heng officer Wang Wen, honored for merit, received a prefectural post at a reduced rank grade.

sentences.zh: 庚午，契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Khitan sent envoys on a courtesy visit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Khitan envoys arrived on a courtesy visit.

sentences.zh: 是日上元節，六街諸寺燃燈，禦乾明門觀之，夜半還宮。

translations.literal: That day was the Lantern Festival; lamps were lit at temples throughout the six wards; the Emperor went to Qianming Gate to view them and returned to the palace at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: That day, on the Lantern Festival, lamps blazed in temples along the six wards; the Emperor viewed them from Qianming Gate and returned to the palace at midnight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，延州節度使丁審琦加爵邑，鄧州節度使安審徽加檢校太傅，陜州節度使石赟加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On renshen, Ding Shenqi, military governor of Yan'an Prefecture, was given added noble rank and fief; An Shenhui, military governor of Deng Prefecture, was given honorary Grand Tutor; Shi Yun, military governor of Shan Prefecture, was given honorary Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Yan'an governor Ding Shenqi received added noble rank and fief; Deng governor An Shenhui and Shan governor Shi Yun were named honorary Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Khitan sent envoys on a courtesy visit.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Khitan envoys arrived on a courtesy visit.

sentences.zh: 河陽節度使兼侍衛馬步軍都虞候景延廣加檢校太尉，改鄆州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: Jing Yanguang, military governor of Heyang and chief adjutant of the palace horse-and-foot armies, was given honorary Grand Commandant, transferred to military governor of Yan Prefecture, and his command of troops remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Heyang governor and palace army chief adjutant Jing Yanguang was named honorary Grand Commandant, moved to Yan, and kept his troop command.

sentences.zh: 以前貝州節度使、北面行營馬步軍都虞候王周為河陽節度使，加檢校太保。

translations.literal: Wang Zhou, former military governor of Bei Prefecture and chief adjutant of the northern headquarters horse-and-foot armies, was made military governor of Heyang and given honorary Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Former Bei governor and northern headquarters army chief adjutant Wang Zhou became Heyang governor and honorary Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以刑部侍郎竇貞固為門下侍郎，以禮部郎中邊歸讜為比部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Dou Zhengu, vice minister of Justice, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Bian Guidan, bureau director in the Ministry of Rites, was made bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Justice vice minister Dou Zhengu became Chancellery vice director; Rites bureau director Bian Guidan became Revenue bureau director and edict drafter.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以河陽節度使王周為涇州節度使，以恒州節度副使王欽祚為殿中監。

translations.literal: On renwu, Wang Zhou, military governor of Heyang, was made military governor of Jing Prefecture; Wang Qinzuo, deputy military governor of Heng Prefecture, was made Director of the Palace Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Heyang governor Wang Zhou took Jing; Heng deputy governor Wang Qinzuo became Palace Directorate director.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，皇妹清平公主進封衛國長公主。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the second month, the Emperor's younger sister, Princess Qingping, was advanced to Elder Princess of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the second month the Emperor's sister Princess Qingping was advanced to Elder Princess of Wei.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使來聘。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys on a courtesy visit.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan envoys arrived on a courtesy visit.

sentences.zh: 己丑，宴於武德殿，新恒州節度使杜重威已下、諸軍副兵馬使已上悉預焉，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On jichou, a banquet was held in Wude Hall; from the new military governor of Heng Prefecture, Du Chongwei, downward, and from deputy army commanders upward, all attended, and gifts were bestowed in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the court feasted in Wude Hall; from new Heng governor Du Chongwei down through deputy army commanders up, all attended and received graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以曹州防禦使何建為延州留後。

translations.literal: On jihai, He Jian, defense commissioner of Cao Prefecture, was made regent of Yan'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Cao defense commissioner He Jian became Yan'an regent.

sentences.zh: 涇州奏，差押牙陳延暉賫敕書往西涼府，本府都指揮使等請以陳延暉為節度使。

translations.literal: Jing Prefecture reported that military adjutant Chen Yanhui had been dispatched bearing an imperial letter to Xiliang Prefecture, and the prefectural commander-in-chief and others requested that Chen Yanhui be made military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Jing reported that adjutant Chen Yanhui had been sent with an imperial letter to Xiliang, where the prefectural commanders asked that he be made governor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宰臣李崧丁母憂，起復舊任。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Chief Minister Li Song entered mourning for his mother and was recalled from mourning to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Chief Minister Li Song mourned his mother and was recalled from mourning to his old post.

sentences.zh: 延州蕃寇作亂，同州、鄜州各起牙兵討平之。

translations.literal: Barbarian raiders rebelled at Yan'an Prefecture; Tong and Fu prefectures each raised personal guards and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarian raiders rose at Yan'an; Tong and Fu each raised guard troops and put the revolt down.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔：「鄧、唐、隨、郢諸州，多有曠土，宜令人戶取便開耕，與免五年差稅。」

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict stated: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and Ying prefectures have much idle land; households should be allowed to open and farm it as convenient, with exemption from corvée and tax levies for five years."
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict declared: "Deng, Tang, Sui, and Ying have much unused land; let households farm it as they choose, exempt from corvée and tax for five years."

sentences.zh: 三月己未，兵部尚書韓惲卒。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the third month, Han Yun, Minister of War, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the third month Minister of War Han Yun died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣前齊州防禦使宋光鄴、翰林茶酒使張言使於契丹。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the former defense commissioner of Qi Prefecture, Song Guangye, and the Hanlin tea-and-wine commissioner, Zhang Yan, were sent as envoys to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen former Qi defense commissioner Song Guangye and Hanlin tea-and-wine commissioner Zhang Yan were dispatched to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，分命朝臣諸寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On renxu, court officials were separately assigned to temples and abbeys to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu court officials were sent separately to temples and abbeys to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇后為妹契丹樞密使趙延壽妻燕國長公主卒於幽州，舉哀於外次。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Empress's younger sister, Princess of Yan, wife of the Khitan commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhao Yanshou, died at You Prefecture, and mourning was raised at the outer pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Empress's sister Princess of Yan, wife of Khitan commissioner Zhao Yanshou, died at Youzhou; mourning was held at the outer pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，滑州節度使、駙馬都尉史匡翰卒，輟朝，贈太保。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Shi Kuanghan, military governor of Hua Prefecture and imperial son-in-law commandant, died; court was suspended, and he was posthumously given Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Hua governor and imperial son-in-law Shi Kuanghan died; court was suspended and he was posthumously named Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔唐州湖陽縣蓼山神祠宜賜號為「蓼山顯順之神」。

translations.literal: An edict stated that the shrine to the god of Liaoshan in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, should be granted the title "Spirit of Manifest Submission of Liaoshan."
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the Liaoshan shrine in Huyang County, Tang Prefecture, the title Spirit of Manifest Submission of Liaoshan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以晉昌軍節度使安審琦為河中節度使，以前亳州防禦使王令溫為貝州節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai, An Shenqi, military governor of the Jinchang army, was made military governor of Hezhong; Wang Lingwen, former defense commissioner of Bo Prefecture, was made military governor of Bei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Jinchang governor An Shenqi took Hezhong; former Bo defense commissioner Wang Lingwen became Bei governor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜宰臣李崧白藤肩輿，以起復故也。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Chief Minister Li Song was granted a white-rattan carrying chair, because he had been recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Chief Minister Li Song received a white-rattan palanquin for his recall from mourning.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以晉州節度使皇甫遇為河陽節度使，以壽州節度使兼侍衛步馬軍指揮使李守貞為滑州節度使，以夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹為相州節度使，皆典軍如故。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Huangfu Yu, military governor of Jin Prefecture, was made military governor of Heyang; Li Shouzhen, military governor of Shou Prefecture and commander of the palace foot-and-horse armies, was made military governor of Hua Prefecture; Guo Jin, military governor of Kui Prefecture and commander of the palace foot armies, was made military governor of Xiang Prefecture—all retained their troop commands.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Jin governor Huangfu Yu took Heyang; Shou governor and palace foot-and-horse commander Li Shouzhen took Hua; Kui governor and palace foot commander Guo Jin took Xiang—all keeping their army commands.

sentences.zh: 宰臣於寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: The chief ministers prayed for rain at temples and abbeys.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers prayed for rain at temples and abbeys.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，以兵部郎中司徒詡為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On bingxu in the intercalary month, Situ Xu, bureau director in the Ministry of War, was made Right Remonstrance Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the intercalary month War bureau director Situ Xu became right remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 戊子，兗州節度使桑維翰加特進，封開國公。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Sang Weihan, military governor of Yan Prefecture, was given special advancement and enfeoffed as Duke Who Opens the State.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Yan governor Sang Weihan received special advancement and was enfeoffed Duke Who Opens the State.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以延州留後何建為延州節度使，以引進使兼殿中監劉政恩為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On gengyin, He Jian, regent of Yan'an Prefecture, was made military governor of Yan'an Prefecture; Liu Zheng'en, introduction commissioner and Director of the Palace Directorate, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yan'an regent He Jian became Yan'an governor; introduction commissioner and Palace Directorate director Liu Zheng'en became Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宋州節度使安彥威奏，修滑州黃河功畢。

translations.literal: On renchen, An Yanwei, military governor of Song Prefecture, reported that work to repair the Yellow River at Hua Prefecture was complete.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Song governor An Yanwei reported that Yellow River repairs at Hua were finished.

sentences.zh: 詔於河決之地建碑立廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that at the site of the river breach a stele be erected and a shrine established.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered a stele and shrine built where the river had broken through.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以鄜州節度使周密為晉州節度使，以左羽林統軍符彥卿為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zhou Mi, military governor of Fu Prefecture, was made military governor of Jin Prefecture; Fu Yanqing, commander of the Left Forest Guard, was made military governor of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Fu governor Zhou Mi took Jin; Left Forest Guard commander Fu Yanqing became Fu governor.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔百官五日一度起居，日輪定兩員，具所見以封事奏聞。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict stated that all officials should attend court every five days; two were fixed by daily rotation, and they were to set forth what they had observed in sealed memorials to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict required officials to attend court every five days, with two fixed by daily rotation to report their observations in sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 詔改鄴都宣明門為朱鳳門；

translations.literal: An edict renamed Yedu's Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed Yedu's Xuaming Gate Zhufeng Gate;

sentences.zh: 武德殿為視政殿，文思殿為崇德殿，畫堂為天清殿，寢殿為乾福殿，其門悉從殿名；

translations.literal: Wude Hall became Shizheng Hall, Wensi Hall became Chongde Hall, Huatang became Tianqing Hall, and the sleeping hall became Qianfu Hall, and their gates all followed the hall names;
translations.idiomatic: Wude Hall became Shizheng Hall, Wensi became Chongde, Huatang became Tianqing, and the sleeping hall became Qianfu, each gate renamed to match;

sentences.zh: 皇城南門為乾明門，北門為元德門，東門為萬春門，西門為千秋門；

translations.literal: the imperial city's south gate became Qianming Gate, the north gate Yuande Gate, the east gate Wanchun Gate, and the west gate Qianqiu Gate;
translations.idiomatic: the imperial city south gate became Qianming, the north Yuande, the east Wanchun, and the west Qianqiu;

sentences.zh: 羅城南磚門為廣運門，觀音門為金明門，橙槽門為清景門，寇氏門為永芳門，朝臣門為景風門；

translations.literal: the outer city's south brick gate became Guangyun Gate, Guanyin Gate became Jinming Gate, Chengcao Gate became Qingjing Gate, Koushi Gate became Yongfang Gate, and Chaochen Gate became Jingfeng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: the outer city south brick gate became Guangyun, Guanyin became Jinming, Chengcao became Qingjing, Koushi became Yongfang, and Chaochen became Jingfeng;

sentences.zh: 大城南門為昭明門，觀音門為廣義門，北河門為靜安門，魏縣門為應福門，寇氏門為迎春門，朝城門為興仁門，上斗門為延清門，下斗門為通遠門。

translations.literal: the great city's south gate became Zhaoming Gate, Guanyin Gate became Guangyi Gate, Beihe Gate became Jing'an Gate, Weixian Gate became Yingfu Gate, Koushi Gate became Yingchun Gate, Chaocheng Gate became Xingren Gate, Shangdou Gate became Yanqing Gate, and Xiadou Gate became Tongyuan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: the great city south gate became Zhaoming, Guanyin became Guangyi, Beihe became Jing'an, Weixian became Yingfu, Koushi became Yingchun, Chaocheng became Xingren, Shangdou became Yanqing, and Xiadou became Tongyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宋州節度使安彥威封邠國公，賞修河之勞也。

translations.literal: On wushen, An Yanwei, military governor of Song Prefecture, was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin, in reward for his labors in repairing the river.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Song governor An Yanwei was enfeoffed Duke of Bin for his river-repair service.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，涇州節度使王周奏，前節度使張彥澤在任日不法事二十六條，已改正停廢。

translations.literal: On guichou, Wang Zhou, military governor of Jing Prefecture, reported that during the tenure of the former military governor Zhang Yanze there had been twenty-six unlawful acts, which had now been corrected and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Jing governor Wang Zhou reported twenty-six unlawful practices from former governor Zhang Yanze's tenure, now corrected and abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔褒之。

translations.literal: An edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 是春，鄴都、鳳翔、兗、陜、汝、恒、陳等州旱，鄆、曹、澶、博、相、洺諸州蝗。

translations.literal: That spring, Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shan, Ru, Heng, and Chen prefectures suffered drought; Yan, Cao, Chan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming prefectures suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Yedu, Fengxiang, Yan, Shan, Ru, Heng, and Chen suffered drought; Yan, Cao, Chan, Bo, Xiang, and Ming suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅朔，避正殿不視朝，日蝕故也。

translations.literal: On the jiayin new moon in summer, fourth month, the main hall was avoided and court was not held, because of a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the fourth month the court avoided the main hall and skipped audience because of a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是日，太陽不虧，百官上表稱賀。

translations.literal: That day the sun was not eclipsed, and the hundred officials submitted memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: That day the sun was not eclipsed, and officials submitted congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 詔沿河藩郡節度使、刺史並兼管內河堤使。

translations.literal: An edict stated that military governors and prefects of riverine frontier prefectures were all additionally to serve as commissioners for dikes within their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made riverine frontier governors and prefects additionally responsible for dikes within their circuits.

sentences.zh: 己未，右諫議大夫鄭受益兩疏論張彥澤在涇州之日，違法虐民，支解掌書記張式、部曲楊洪等，請下所司，明申其罪。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Zheng Shouyi, Right Remonstrance Councillor, submitted two memorials stating that during Zhang Yanze's days at Jing Prefecture he had violated the law and abused the people, dismembering Chief Secretary Zhang Shi and retainers Yang Hong and others, and requesting that the matter be referred to the relevant offices to clarify and declare his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei right remonstrator Zheng Shouyi submitted two memorials charging that Zhang Yanze had broken the law and abused the people while at Jing, dismembering chief secretary Zhang Shi and retainers including Yang Hong, and asking that the case be referred to the proper offices to establish his guilt.

sentences.zh: 皆留中不出。

translations.literal: Both were held at court and not released.
translations.idiomatic: Both memorials were held at court and never released.

sentences.zh: 庚申，刑部郎中李濤、張麟，員外郎麻麟、王禧，同詣閣門上疏，論張彥澤罪犯，詞甚懇切。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Li Tao and Zhang Lin, bureau directors in the Ministry of Justice, together with Ma Lin and Wang Xi, bureau vice-directors, all went together to the Gate office to submit a memorial discussing Zhang Yanzhe's crimes, the language extremely earnest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Tao and Zhang Lin of the Justice bureau, together with vice-directors Ma Lin and Wang Xi, jointly submitted a memorial at the Gate office on Zhang Yanzhe's crimes, their language intensely earnest.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《宋史·李濤傳》：涇帥張彥澤殺記室張式，奪其妻，式家人詣闕上訴，晉祖以彥澤有軍功，釋其罪。

translations.literal: (The 《Song History · Biography of Li Tao》 states: Jing military governor Zhang Yanzhe killed clerk Zhang Shi and seized his wife; Shi's family went to court to appeal, and Emperor Gaozu of Jin, because Yanzhe had military merit, released him from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Song History · Li Tao》 records that Jing governor Zhang Yanzhe murdered clerk Zhang Shi and took his wife. When Shi's family appealed at court, Emperor Gaozu of Jin pardoned Yanzhe for his martial service.

sentences.zh: 濤伏閣抗疏，請置於法。

translations.literal: Tao lay prostrate at the Gate and submitted a remonstrance, requesting that he be placed under the law.
translations.idiomatic: Tao prostrated himself at the Gate in remonstrance, demanding that Yanzhe be punished by law.

sentences.zh: 晉祖召見諭之，濤植笏叩階，聲色俱厲，晉祖怒叱之，濤執笏如初。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu of Jin summoned him and instructed him; Tao planted his tablet and knocked the steps, voice and countenance both severe; Emperor Gaozu angrily shouted at him, but Tao held his tablet as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu summoned him and tried to reason with him. Tao planted his court tablet and struck the steps, his voice and face fierce. Gaozu shouted him down, but Tao kept his tablet raised as before.

sentences.zh: 晉祖曰：「吾與彥澤有誓約，恕其死。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu of Jin said: "I have a sworn pact with Yanzhe; I pardon his death.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu said, "Yanzhe and I have a sworn pact; his life is spared.

sentences.zh: 」濤厲聲曰：「彥澤私誓，陛下不忍食其言；

translations.literal: " Tao said in a harsh voice: "Yanzhe's was a private oath—Your Majesty cannot bear to swallow your own word;
translations.idiomatic: " Tao thundered, "That was Yanzhe's private pledge. Your Majesty cannot bear to swallow your word;

sentences.zh: 範延光嘗賜鐵券，今復安在？

translations.literal: Fan Yanguang was once granted an iron certificate—where is it now?
translations.idiomatic: yet where is the iron certificate Fan Yanguang was once granted?

sentences.zh: 」晉祖不能答，即拂衣起。）〉

translations.literal: " Emperor Gaozu of Jin could not answer and immediately shook out his robes and rose.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozu had no reply and rose abruptly.)〉

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：「張彥澤刳剔賓從，誅剝生聚，冤聲穢跡，流聞四方，章表繼來，指陳甚切。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict stated: "Zhang Yanzhe disemboweled and flayed retainers, executed and stripped the living and gathered, cries of injustice and foul deeds spreading in all directions; memorials have come in succession, pointing and stating with great urgency.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict declared: "Zhang Yanzhe has mutilated retainers and preyed on the populace; cries of injustice and foul deeds have spread everywhere, and memorial after memorial has pressed the case relentlessly.

sentences.zh: 尚以曾施微功，特示寬恩。

translations.literal: Still, because he once rendered slight merit, special leniency is shown.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because he once rendered some service, extraordinary clemency is granted.

sentences.zh: 深懷曲法之慚，貴徇議勞之典。

translations.literal: We deeply harbor the shame of bending the law, valuing the precedent of honoring those who remonstrate.
translations.idiomatic: We deeply regret bending the law and honor those who have pressed this case.

sentences.zh: 其張彥澤宜削一階，仍降爵一紀。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanzhe should have one rank stripped and his nobility reduced by one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanzhe is to be demoted one rank and stripped of one grade of nobility.

sentences.zh: 其張式宜贈官，張式父鐸、弟守貞、男希範並與除官。

translations.literal: Zhang Shi should receive posthumous office; Shi's father Duo, younger brother Shouzhen, and son Xifan are all to be given offices.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shi is to receive posthumous rank; his father Duo, brother Shouzhen, and son Xifan are all to be appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 仍於涇州賜錢十萬，差人津置張式靈柩並骨肉歸鄉，所有先收納卻張式家財物畜，並令卻還。

translations.literal: Further, one hundred thousand cash is granted at Jing Prefecture, men dispatched to escort Zhang Shi's bier and kin home; all household goods and livestock previously seized from Zhang Shi's family are ordered returned.
translations.idiomatic: Further, a hundred thousand cash is granted at Jing Prefecture to convey Zhang Shi's coffin and family home; all property and livestock seized from his household must be restored.

sentences.zh: 其涇州新歸業戶，量與蠲減稅賦。

translations.literal: For newly returned households at Jing Prefecture, taxes and levies are to be reduced according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Newly returned households in Jing Prefecture are to receive proportionate tax relief.

sentences.zh: 」翌日，以前涇州節度使張彥澤為左龍武大將軍。

translations.literal: " The next day, the former military governor of Jing Prefecture, Zhang Yanzhe, was made Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: " The next day former Jing governor Zhang Yanzhe was named Grand General of the Left Dragon Martial Guard.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《宋史·楊昭儉傳》：昭儉與李濤論張彥澤不報，會有詔命朝臣轉對，或有封事，亦許以不時條奏。

translations.literal: (The 《Song History · Biography of Yang Zhaojian》 states: Zhaojian memorialized together with Li Tao on Zhang Yanzhe but received no response; just then there came an edict ordering court officials to take turns in audience, and permitting sealed memorials or timely ad hoc submissions.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Song History · Yang Zhaojian》 records that Zhaojian joined Li Tao in memorializing against Zhang Yanzhe without reply; then an edict ordered officials to take turns at audience and permitted sealed or timely memorials.

sentences.zh: 昭儉復上疏曰：「天子君臨四海，日有萬幾，懋建諍臣，彌縫其闕。

translations.literal: Zhaojian again submitted a memorial saying: "The Son of Heaven rules over the four seas, daily affairs ten thousand; vigorously establish remonstrating ministers to mend gaps.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaojian submitted again: "The Son of Heaven rules the four seas with ten thousand affairs daily; remonstrating ministers exist to mend his flaws.

sentences.zh: 今則諫臣雖設，言路不通。

translations.literal: Now remonstrators exist in name but the path of speech does not reach through.
translations.idiomatic: Yet though remonstrators exist, the path of speech is blocked.

sentences.zh: 藥石之論，不達於聖聰，而邪佞之徒，取容於左右。

translations.literal: Salutary counsel does not reach the sage ear, while flatterers and sycophants win favor at the Emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: Salutary counsel never reaches the throne, while flatterers win favor at court.

sentences.zh: 御史臺紀綱之府，彈糾之司。

translations.literal: The Censorate is the house of discipline, the office of impeachment and inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate is meant to uphold discipline and investigate wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 銜冤者固當昭雪，為蠹者難免放流。

translations.literal: Those bearing injustice should surely be cleared; those who are corrupt can hardly escape banishment.
translations.idiomatic: The wronged should be vindicated and the corrupt banished.

sentences.zh: 陛下臨御以來，寬仁太甚，徒置兩司，殆如虛器。

translations.literal: Since Your Majesty began to reign, leniency has been excessive; the two offices stand idle, nearly like empty vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Since Your Majesty's accession, leniency has been so extreme that these two offices stand nearly empty.

sentences.zh: 遂令節使慢侮朝章，屠害幕吏。

translations.literal: Thus military commissioners scorn court law and slaughter staff officers.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioners now scorn court law and slaughter staff officers at will.

sentences.zh: 始訴冤於丹闕，反執送於本藩，茍安跋扈之心，莫恤冤抑之苦。

translations.literal: They first appeal injustice at the crimson gate but are instead sent back bound to their circuits; they indulge arrogant hearts and care nothing for the pain of suppressed injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Victims appeal at the palace gate only to be handed back to their abusers, who grow ever bolder and heed no suffering they cause.

sentences.zh: 願回宸斷，誅彥澤以謝軍吏。）〉

translations.literal: We pray Your Majesty reconsider and execute Yanzhe to answer the officers and soldiers.)〉
translations.idiomatic: We beg Your Majesty to reconsider and execute Yanzhe in answer to his victims.)〉

sentences.zh: 戊辰，廢雄州為昌化軍，警州為威肅軍，其軍使委本道差補。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Xiong Prefecture was abolished as Changhua Army, Jing Prefecture as Weisu Army; their army commissioners were entrusted for appointment to their circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Xiong Prefecture was reclassified as the Changhua Army and Jing as the Weisu Army; army commissioners were to be appointed by their circuits.

sentences.zh: 故涇州節度掌書記張式贈尚書虞部郎中，以式父鐸為沁州司馬致仕，弟守貞為貝州清河縣主簿，男希範為興元府文學。

translations.literal: The late clerk of the Jing military governor, Zhang Shi, received posthumous appointment as Bureau Director in the Ministry of Public Works under the Secretariat; Shi's father Duo was made retired Qinzhou military adjutant, younger brother Shouzhen registrar of Qinghe County in Bei Prefecture, son Xifan literary officer of Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Late Jing governor's clerk Zhang Shi was posthumously named a director in the Works bureau; his father Duo received honorary retirement as Qinzhou adjutant, brother Shouzhen became Qinghe registrar in Bei Prefecture, and son Xifan literary officer at Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔皇子齊王就前河中府節度使康福第，以教坊樂宴會前、見任節度使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict had the imperial prince, Prince of Qi, visit the residence of former Heyang military governor Kang Fu, with Music Bureau performers to banquet former and current military governors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Emperor ordered Prince Qi to visit former Heyang governor Kang Fu's residence and entertain former and current governors with Music Bureau performers.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，前慶州刺史米廷訓追奪在身官爵，配流麟州，坐奸妻兄之女也。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Mi Tingxun, former prefect of Qing Prefecture, had his current office and titles stripped and was banished to Lin Prefecture, for having violated his wife's elder brother's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin former Qing prefect Mi Tingxun was stripped of rank and exiled to Lin Prefecture for seducing his wife's brother's daughter.

sentences.zh: 是月，州郡十六處蝗。

translations.literal: That month, locusts struck sixteen prefectures and commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts infested sixteen jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，中書門下奏：「時屬炎蒸，事宜簡省。

translations.literal: On fifth month, jihai, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "The season now belongs to sweltering heat; affairs should be simplified.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month the Secretariat-Chancellery reported: "In the heat of summer, court business should be simplified.

sentences.zh: 應五日百官起居，望令押班宰臣一員押百官班，其轉對官兩員封付閣門使引進，本官隨百僚退，不用別出謝恩。

translations.literal: For the five-day imperial audience of all officials, it is hoped one ranking chief minister may lead the officials' formation; the two turn-taking officials shall seal and deliver to the Gate commissioner for presentation, the officials themselves retiring with the hundred officials without separate appearance to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: For quintweekly imperial audiences, one chief minister should lead the official formation; the two rotating memorialists should submit sealed petitions through the Gate commissioner and withdraw with the court without separate thanksgiving audiences.

sentences.zh: 其文武內外官僚乞假、寧覲、搬家、婚葬、病損並門見門辭。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials within and without, requesting leave, visiting parents, moving house, marriage, burial, or illness, all receive audience at the Gate for arrival and departure.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials requesting leave, family visits, moves, weddings, funerals, or sick leave should all take audience at the Gate on arrival and departure.

sentences.zh: 諸道進奉物等，不用殿前排列，引進使引至殿前奏云『某等進奉』，奏訖，令進奉使便出。

translations.literal: Tribute goods from all circuits need not line up before the hall; the presenting commissioner leads them before the hall and reports "We present tribute," and when finished the tribute envoys withdraw at once.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit tribute need not be arrayed before the hall; presenting commissioners should announce "We present tribute" at the hall and withdraw immediately afterward.

sentences.zh: 其進奉專使朝見日，班首一人致詞，都附起居。

translations.literal: On days when tribute envoys attend audience, one head of formation speaks, all attached to the imperial audience.
translations.idiomatic: When tribute envoys attend audience, one spokesman should address the throne as part of the general audience.

sentences.zh: 刺史並行軍副使、諸道馬步軍都指揮使已下，差人到闕，並門見門辭。

translations.literal: Prefects, campaign deputy commissioners, and circuit horse-and-foot army commanders and below, when dispatching men to court, all receive Gate audience for arrival and departure.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from prefects, campaign deputies, and circuit army commanders should take Gate audience on arrival and departure.

sentences.zh: 州縣官謝恩日，甲頭一人都致詞，不用逐人告官。

translations.literal: On thanksgiving days for county and prefecture officials, one squad head addresses collectively without each person reporting his office individually.
translations.idiomatic: When local officials give thanks, one squad spokesman should address the throne without each man announcing his title.

sentences.zh: 其供奉官、殿直等，如是當直及合於殿前排立者，即入起居；

translations.literal: For palace attendants, hall guards, and the like, if on duty and due to stand before the hall, they enter for audience;
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendants and hall guards on duty who are to stand before the hall should attend audience;

sentences.zh: 如不當直排立者，不用每日起居。

translations.literal: if not on duty to stand in formation, they need not daily audience.
translations.idiomatic: those not on such duty need not attend daily audience.

sentences.zh: 委宣徽使點檢，常須整齊。

translations.literal: This is entrusted to the Palace Commissioner for inspection; order must be maintained at all times.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Commissioner should inspect and keep proceedings in order.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 時帝不豫，難於視朝故也。

translations.literal: At this time the Emperor was ill and found it difficult to hold court—hence this measure.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was then unwell and unable to hold regular court, which explains these measures.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《遼史》：二月甲午，遣使使晉，索吐谷渾叛者。

translations.literal: (The 《Liao History》 states: On second month, jiawu, an envoy was sent to Jin to demand the Tuyuhun rebels.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Liao History》 records that on jiawu of the second month Liao sent envoys to Jin demanding the surrender of Tuyuhun rebels.

sentences.zh: 《契丹國志》云：遼以晉招納吐谷渾，遣使責讓，晉高祖憂悒成疾。）〉

translations.literal: The 《Khitan State Record》 says: Because Jin had harbored the Tuyuhun, Liao sent envoys to rebuke them, and Emperor Gaozu of Jin fell ill from worry.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The 《Khitan State Record》 adds that Jin's sheltering of the Tuyuhun provoked Liao's reproach, and Emperor Gaozu grew ill from distress.)〉

sentences.zh: 左威衛上將軍衛審餘卒，贈太子少保。

translations.literal: Wei Shenyu, Senior General of the Left Majestic Guard, died; he was posthumously named Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Shenyu, Senior General of the Left Majestic Guard, died and was posthumously named Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，尊皇太妃劉氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: On yisi, Imperial Consort Liu was honored as Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Imperial Consort Liu was elevated to Empress Dowager.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （徐無黨《五代史記註》云：高祖所生母也。）〉

translations.literal: (Xu Wudang's 《Notes to the Record of the Five Dynasties》 states: She was Gaozu's birth mother.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Xu Wudang's 《Notes to the Record of the Five Dynasties》 says she was Gaozu's biological mother.)〉

sentences.zh: 丁未，工部侍郎韋勛改刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Wei Xun, vice minister of Works, was transferred to vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Works vice minister Wei Xun became Justice vice minister.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以左散騎常侍李光廷為秘書監，給事中蕭願為右散騎常侍，左諫議大夫曹國珍為給事中，太常卿裴坦為左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On renzi, Li Guangting, Left Regular Attendant of Cavalry, was made Director of the Secretariat; Xiao Yuan, supervising secretary, was made Right Regular Attendant of Cavalry; Cao Guozhen, left remonstrance grandee, was made supervising secretary; Pei Tan, Director of State Ceremonial, was made left remonstrance grandee.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Li Guangting became Secretariat director; Xiao Yuan became Right Cavalry Attendant; Cao Guozhen became supervising secretary; Pei Tan became left remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 是月，州郡五奏大水，十八奏旱蝗。

translations.literal: That month, five prefectures reported great floods and eighteen reported drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month five circuits reported major floods and eighteen reported drought and locust damage.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，以兗州節度使桑維翰為晉昌軍節度使，以前許州節度使安審琦為兗州節度使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingsi, Sang Weihan, military governor of Yan Prefecture, was made military governor of the Jinchang army; An Shenqi, former military governor of Xu Prefecture, was made military governor of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the sixth month Yan governor Sang Weihan took Jinchang; former Xu governor An Shenqi became Yan governor.

sentences.zh: 襄州都部署高行周奏，安從進觀察判官李光圖出城請援，送赴闕。

translations.literal: Gao Xingzhou, overall deployer of Xiang Prefecture, reported that Li Guangtu, observation judge under An Congjin, left the city to request aid and was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang deployer Gao Xingzhou reported Congjin's judge Li Guangtu had left the city seeking aid and was escorted to court.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，帝崩於保昌殿，壽五十一。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Emperor died in the Hall of Baochang, aged fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Emperor died in Baochang Hall at the age of fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 遺制齊王重貴於柩前即皇帝位，喪紀並依舊制，山陵務從節儉，馬步諸軍優紀並從嗣君處分。

translations.literal: His testamentary order made Prince of Qi Chonggui assume the imperial throne before the coffin; mourning rites followed the old regulations; the mausoleum was to be kept frugal; preferential treatment for horse and foot armies was left to the disposition of the successor.
translations.idiomatic: By his final order Prince of Qi Chonggui took the throne before the bier; mourning followed precedent; the tomb was to be kept frugal; and army benefits were left to the new emperor.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒考異》云：《漢高祖實錄》：晉高祖大漸，召近臣屬之曰：「此天下，明宗之天下，寡人竊而處之久矣。

translations.literal: (The 《Examination of Variants to the Comprehensive Mirror》 states: The 《Veritable Record of Han Gaozu》: As Jin Gaozu grew critically ill, he summoned close ministers and entrusted them, saying: "This realm is Mingzong's realm; I have merely held it in usurpation for long."
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Examination of Variants to the Comprehensive Mirror》 cites the 《Veritable Record of Han Gaozu》: As Gaozu lay dying he summoned close ministers and said, "This realm is Mingzong's; I have only held it in usurpation for years."

sentences.zh: 寡人既謝，當歸許王，寡人之願也。

translations.literal: When I depart, it should return to the Prince of Xu—that is my wish."
translations.idiomatic: When I am gone it should return to the Prince of Xu—that is my wish."

sentences.zh: 」此說難信。）〉

translations.literal: " This account is hard to credit.)〉
translations.idiomatic: " This account is hard to believe.)〉

sentences.zh: 八月，太常卿崔棁上謚曰聖文章武明德孝皇帝，廟號高祖。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Cui Zheng, Director of State Ceremonial, submitted the posthumous title Emperor Shengwen Zhangwu Mingde Xiao, with temple name Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Director of State Ceremonial Cui Zheng proposed the posthumous title Shengwen Zhangwu Mingde Xiao and the temple name Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 以其年十一月十日庚寅葬於顯陵，宰臣和凝撰謚冊哀冊文。

translations.literal: On the tenth day of the eleventh month of that year, on gengyin, he was buried at Xianling; Chief Minister He Ning composed the posthumous patent and lament texts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the tenth of the eleventh month, he was buried at Xianling; Chief Minister He Ning wrote the posthumous patent and lament.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代史補》：高祖尚明宗女，宮中謂之石郎。

translations.literal: (The 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》: Gaozu married Mingzong's daughter; within the palace he was called Lord Stone.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》 says Gaozu married Mingzong's daughter and was known in the palace as Lord Stone.

sentences.zh: 及將起兵於太原，京師夜間狼皆群走，往往入宮中，湣帝患之，命諸班能射者分頭捕逐，謂之「射狼」。

translations.literal: When he was about to raise troops at Taiyuan, at night in the capital wolves ran in packs, often entering the palace; Emperor Min was troubled and ordered skilled archers of the guard shifts to hunt them separately, calling it "shooting wolves."
translations.idiomatic: As he prepared to raise troops at Taiyuan, wolves ran in packs through the capital at night and often entered the palace; Emperor Min ordered the best archers of the guard to hunt them, calling it "shooting wolves."

sentences.zh: 或遇諸塗，問曰：「汝何從而來？

translations.literal: Meeting people on the roads, they would ask: "Where are you coming from?"
translations.idiomatic: Meeting people on the road they would ask, "Where are you coming from?"

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「看射狼。

translations.literal: " They would answer: "To watch the wolf-shooting."
translations.idiomatic: " They would answer, "To watch the wolf-shooting."

sentences.zh: 」未幾，高祖至。

translations.literal: " Before long, Gaozu arrived.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long Gaozu arrived.

sentences.zh: 蓋「射」韻「石」相近也。

translations.literal: For the rhyme of "shoot" is close to "stone."
translations.idiomatic: For the rhyme of "shoot" (she) was close to "stone" (shi).

sentences.zh: 《五代史闕文》：梁開平初，潞州行營使李思安奏：函關縣穰鄉民伐樹，樹仆，自分為二，中有六字如左書，云「天十四載石進」，梁帝藏於武庫，時莫詳其義。

translations.literal: The 《Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties》: At the beginning of Kaiping of Liang, Li Si'an, field-camp commissioner of Lu Prefecture, reported: In Rang township of Hanguan County, when commoners felled a tree it fell and split of itself in two; within were six characters written like the left-hand script, reading "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances"; the Liang Emperor stored it in the armory, and at the time none could explain its meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Lost Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties》 records that early in Liang's Kaiping era Lu field commissioner Li Si'an reported: In Hanguan's Rang township a felled tree split in two, revealing six characters in left-hand script: "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances." The Liang emperor stored it in the armory; none then knew what it meant.

sentences.zh: 至帝即位，識者曰：「天」字取「四」字兩畫加之於傍，即「丙」字也；

translations.literal: When the Emperor took the throne, those who understood said: The character "Heaven" takes the two strokes of "Four" and adds them at the side, making the character "Bing";
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne interpreters said: "Heaven" with two strokes of "Four" added beside it forms "Bing";

sentences.zh: 「四」字去中之兩畫加「十」字，即「申」字也。

translations.literal: "Four" with its middle two strokes removed and "Ten" added makes "Shen."
translations.idiomatic: "Four" with its middle strokes removed and "Ten" added makes "Shen."

sentences.zh: 帝即位之年，乃「丙申」也。

translations.literal: The year the Emperor took the throne was indeed bingshen.
translations.idiomatic: The year of his accession was indeed bingshen.

sentences.zh: 進者晉也，石者姓也。

translations.literal: "Advances" means Jin; "Stone" is the surname.
translations.idiomatic: "Advances" meant Jin; "Stone" was the surname.

sentences.zh: 臣謹按，天祐二十年，歲在癸未，其年莊宗建號，改同光元年，至清泰三年，歲丙申，其年晉祖即位，改元天福元年，自未至申，凡十四載矣，故讖書云「天十四載石進」者，言自天祐滅後十四載石氏興於晉也，豈不明乎！

translations.literal: Your servant respectfully notes: In the twentieth year of Tianyou, the year was in guiwei; that year Zhuangzong established his reign title and changed to the first year of Tongguang; down to the third year of Qingtai, the year bingshen, the year Jin Ancestor took the throne and changed the era to the first year of Tianfu—from wei to shen was fourteen reigns in all. Thus the prophecy saying "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances" means that fourteen reigns after Tianyou's end the Shi clan rose in Jin—is this not clear!
translations.idiomatic: This commentator notes: Tianyou 20 was guiwei, when Zhuangzong took the throne as Tongguang 1; by Qingtai 3, bingshen, when the Jin founder acceded as Tianfu 1, fourteen reign-years had passed from wei to shen. So "Heaven, fourteen reigns, Stone advances" means fourteen years after Tianyou the Shi house rose in Jin—is that not plain!

sentences.zh: 而拆字解讖以就丙申，非也。）〉

translations.literal: Yet to split characters to force the prophecy onto bingshen is wrong.)〉
translations.idiomatic: But splitting characters to force a bingshen reading is wrong.)〉

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：晉祖潛躍之前沈毅而已。

translations.literal: The historiographer states: Before Jin Ancestor's hidden rise he was merely deep and resolute.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer writes: Before his rise Gaozu was known only for quiet resolve.

sentences.zh: 及其為君也，旰食宵衣，禮賢從諫，慕黃、老之教，樂清凈之風，以絁為衣，以麻為履，故能保其社稷，高朗令終。

translations.literal: When he became ruler, he toiled from dawn to dusk and rose at night, honored the worthy and accepted remonstrance, admired the teaching of Huangdi and Laozi, delighted in purity and restraint, wore coarse silk for garments and hemp for shoes—thus he could preserve his altars and states and end his life in lofty clarity.
translations.idiomatic: As ruler he labored from dawn to dusk, honored worthies and heeded counsel, cherished the teachings of Huangdi and Laozi and the way of simplicity, wore coarse silk and hemp shoes, and so preserved the realm and died with honor.

sentences.zh: 然而圖事之初，召戎來援，獫狁自茲而孔熾，黔黎由是以罹殃。

translations.literal: Yet at the beginning of his plotting he summoned the Rong for aid; from then the Xianyun grew greatly fierce, and the black-haired people thereby suffered calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in seeking power he called in the northern tribes; from then the frontier grew ever more dangerous and the people paid the price.

sentences.zh: 迨至嗣君，兵連禍結，卒使都城失守，舉族為俘。

translations.literal: By the time of the successor, war linked with disaster; in the end the capital fell, and the whole clan was taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: Under his successor war and disaster compounded until the capital fell and the house was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 亦猶決鯨海以救焚，何逃沒溺；

translations.literal: It is like breaching the whale-sea to save a fire—how escape drowning;
translations.idiomatic: It was like breaching the sea to fight a fire—drowning was inevitable;

sentences.zh: 飲鴆漿而止渴，終取喪亡。

translations.literal: drinking poison to quench thirst, and in the end inviting ruin.
translations.idiomatic: drinking poison to slake thirst, and inviting ruin in the end.

sentences.zh: 謀之不臧，何至於是！

translations.literal: Ill counsel—how did it come to this!
translations.idiomatic: Poor counsel brought matters to this pass!

sentences.zh: 倘使非由外援之力，自副皇天之命，以茲睿德，惠彼蒸民，雖未足以方駕前王，亦可謂仁慈恭儉之主也。

translations.literal: Had it not been for the power of foreign aid, had he matched Heaven's mandate by this sagely virtue and shown kindness to the black-haired people, though he might not have equaled former kings, he could still be called a ruler of benevolence, respect, and frugality.
translations.idiomatic: Without reliance on foreign arms, had he truly matched Heaven's mandate and blessed the people with this wisdom, he might not have equaled the greatest of antiquity, yet he could still be called a benevolent, respectful, and frugal sovereign.
